title: Revisiting Reciprocal Recommender Systems: Metrics, Formulation, and Method

problem.claim: Reciprocal recommender systems conduct bilateral recommendations between two parties and aim to improve matching efficiency.

gap.claim: Existing methods mostly reuse conventional ranking metrics to assess each side separately, overlooking the collective effect of both ranking outcomes and the need for holistic evaluation and a systemic solution.

narrative_sequence.summary: Reciprocal recommender systems perform bilateral recommendations to improve matching efficiency.
Most existing methods evaluate recommendation performance separately for each side using conventional ranking metrics.
Separate evaluation fails to account for the joint influence of both ranking outcomes and leaves a need for holistic evaluation and a systemic solution.
